findings.headline: Remove this /*@once*/ marker; the expression after it is now reactive.
findings.why: Solid 1.x compiled a /*@once*/ expression as a one-time read. Solid 2.0.3 ignores the marker, so the value now updates when its signals change.
findings.guidance: Delete the comment and keep the expression reactive where updates are fine. For an initial value on a DOM input, use the default prop instead (value to defaultValue, checked to defaultChecked); to seed local state, use a writable derived signal, createSignal(() => props.initial). Only where the value must never update and never comes from async data, read it once with untrack in the component body and pass the local; never use untrack just to silence STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED.
